# Draft identity cleanup empties Drafts before removing the test account

This landing restores main-window focus, awaits the shared Drafts-emptying helper, then removes identities and the test account. The helper registers deletion events before simulating the key and waits for the message count to decrease. That order is source-supported; native focus/deletion behavior and the reported intermittent were not reproduced or verified.

Scope: Compose draft identity test cleanup.
